name: switch_to_developer_mode
description: Switch this conversation into developer/plugin-authoring mode. Call this instead of attempting the request yourself when the customer needs plugin authoring or validation (checking/fixing a plugin's profile.json), UOM/property-id lookup, generating or regenerating a plugin scaffold, installing a generated (not store) plugin, configuring developer settings, or setting up a dev venv/VS Code debug config. Do not call this for anything already answerable with your current tools (listing/installing/calling/testing an already-installed plugin, device/routine/group control, diagnostics) -- those work the same in both modes. Developer mode has its own separate conversation history and cannot see anything said in this one, so it relies entirely on handoff_summary to know what's going on -- after a successful switch, the customer's request is already being continued on your behalf using that summary; do not ask them to repeat themselves. If this returns an error (not enabled here, or already switched the maximum number of times this request), explain that plainly instead of attempting the request anyway.

handoff_summary.description: What the customer wants and why you're switching, in your own words, in 1-3 sentences -- e.g. "Customer wants a custom plugin for their SimpliSafe alarm; no store plugin exists for it. They confirmed by selecting the 'develop a custom plugin' option I offered." This is the *only* context developer mode will have -- it cannot see any of this conversation's history -- so include whatever's actually needed to pick up where you left off (what device/service, what they've already tried or rejected, any specifics they already gave).
